notes.title: Update 1.7
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11607168/7ea9203cd68e0ee10c313840b67bdf21a94f59a4.jpg

WHAT'S NEW

Added Instrument Chord mode!
Audio Export reworked (added faster offline export mode and optional looping)
Added Export to mp3 (PC only)
CLIP EDIT: Play instrument by PC/Mac Keyboard – two octaves, lower starts at C-key, higher starts at R-key
CLIP EDIT: Shift+LMB on fx area → reset area value to default
BUG FIX: ARP was not performing correctly in Poly 2,3,4 modes.
Few other minor bug fixes


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11607168/389b00946627a09c0535d8ff10e66101773821a6.jpg

Instrument Chord mode

Allows multiple notes to be played at once from one instrument
Pressing PC/Mac Keyboard rewrites selected note(s)
CTRL+ PC/Mac Keyboard adds note(s) to selected position
LMB at pitch note area transposes selected chord
CTRL+LMB – adds note to the chord or adjusts selected note pitch
CTRL+RMB – removes last note from the chord
Adjust note VOLUME or parameters B,C,D by LMB - set all chord notes together. Or LMB + CTRL - set only selected note.

notes.title: Major Update 1.5
notes.notes:
Wide effect – two chorus modes with stereo spread
DrSynth 2 – adds slightly different and smoother sound character
Clip Channel linking and group editing – linked channels are triggered by the first channel notes. Linking with CTRL also copies instrument settings except pitch. This can be used for easy chords making. When channels are linked than adjusting instrument settings with CTRL adjusts all linked channels.
 Steam chat integration – dblclick on AUTHOR name in song browser opens Steam chat with this user.
In song mode, dblclick with CTRL sets Left loop marker and dblclick with ALT sets Right loop marker.
Some minor bug fixes
